autumnleaves.html.description: Red, orange, and yellow leaves tumble across the screen and gather into a loose pile along the bottom.

blob.html.description: Soft, rounded color blobs swell and overlap, forming slow, liquid-like shapes.

bounce.html.description: A glowing rounded-square mark bounces across the screen, squashing and stretching at each impact.

bubbles.html.description: Translucent bubbles of different sizes float upward and pop against a dark background.

circuitboard.html.description: Glowing right-angled traces form a branching circuit pattern as bright pulses travel along the paths.

city.html.description: A layered city skyline with lit windows sits beneath a sky that shifts between dusk and night.

constellation.html.description: Small glowing stars drift and connect with thin lines, forming shifting constellations.

cymatics.html.description: Thousands of tiny points gather into symmetrical wave patterns that slowly morph from one shape to another.

fireworks.html.description: Bright bursts of colored sparks bloom, scatter, and fade across a dark sky.

flow.html.description: Fine glowing particles trace curved, flowing paths that fade into the background.

gameoflife.html.description: A grid of glowing cells grows and changes in clusters, leaving shifting gaps of dark space.

glitch.html.description: Colorful geometric shapes slide and rotate beneath brief bands of visual distortion.

kaleidoscope.html.description: Glowing circular motifs repeat in mirrored wedges, slowly rotating into kaleidoscopic patterns.

lanterns.html.description: Glowing paper lanterns drift upward beneath a field of twinkling stars.

magnetic-field-lines.html.description: Curving luminous paths loop around shifting points while tiny particles follow the lines.

metaphysical-horizon.html.description: Seven soft pools of colored light overlap and slowly pulse across a dark field.

n-body-galaxies.html.description: Two dense star systems swirl toward one another, their glowing stars leaving faint trails.

organic-harmonic-field.html.description: Layered bands of color bend and ripple into a flowing, organic wave pattern.

origami.html.description: A grid of diamond-shaped tiles slowly flips between two colors.

papercranes.html.description: A flock of folded paper cranes glides across a softly shaded sky, their wings gently flapping.

quantum-interference.html.description: Overlapping circular waves create shifting bands of light around several moving points.

rain-on-a-window.html.description: Water droplets bead and slide down a glass-like surface in front of softly blurred lights.

rain.html.description: Slanting rain streaks cross a dark sky, punctuated by brief flashes of lightning.

sakura.html.description: Cherry-blossom petals drift and turn slowly across the screen.

soft-body-creatures.html.description: Soft, translucent blobs wobble, stretch, and drift as their rounded outlines change shape.

solar-system.html.description: A bright central sun anchors orbiting planets, with faint star clouds and compact spaceflight readouts.

starfield.html.description: A sparse field of stars drifts across layered, softly glowing nebula clouds.

strange-attractor-flow.html.description: Glowing particles curl through a continuously twisting, looped pattern, leaving fading trails.

typewriter.html.description: Lines of text appear one character at a time on a dark screen, followed by a blinking cursor.

voronoi.html.description: A shifting mosaic of irregular polygon cells fills the screen with softly glowing edges.

wave-function-collapse.html.description: A grid of glowing line segments, corners, and junctions gradually resolves into a connected pattern, then fades.

aurora-veil.html.description: Wide ribbons of colored light drift and overlap, forming a slow, softly glowing veil across the sky.

koi-pond.html.description: Several koi glide through dark water, leaving slow ripples that spread and fade behind them.

constellation-clock.html.description: Stars drift into glowing numeral shapes, linking with faint lines that reform each minute.

abyssal-drift.html.description: A slow descent through deep water: drifting jellyfish, falling marine snow and faint bioluminescent flashes.

turing-garden.html.description: Self-organizing chemical patterns grow into spots, stripes and spirals that keep reorganizing.

analog-clockwork.html.description: A precision dial with sweeping hands, turning gears and a steady escapement.

julia-bloom.html.description: A fractal bloom slowly zooms and changes shape as its parameter drifts.
